notes: Single-stage C lifecycle repair: the abort path of batchstat terminates with a raw _exit call that short-circuits the atexit-registered cleanup_registry, leaving the registry on the heap at exit and skipping the report's audit line. The fix must return normally (or via exit) so the registered destructor-style cleanup actually runs on both exit paths. The verifier rebuilds from the delivered source, runs under Valgrind with --errors-for-leak-kinds=all plus an 'in use at exit: 0 bytes' check on five hidden inputs (including abort paths with populated and empty registries, and a boundary-at-limit success), byte-compares stdout/exit-code/report, checks protected files, and rejects short-circuit/suppression tokens (_exit/_Exit/quick_exit/abort/VALGRIND_) in the source. Nonzero rubric for tool_breadth (make + valgrind), reasoning_depth and debugging_ambiguity (identify the lifecycle root cause rather than patch symptoms), adversarial_inputs and hidden_case_generalization (six graded runs incl. hidden CRLF/no-newline and boundary cases), and unsafe_action_penalty (workarounds such as suppression or exit-without-cleanup are penalized by construction). Totals bucket to medium.
